newsitem.title: USA: Kids World sues Toys R Us over trademark.
newsitem.headline: Kids World sues Toys R Us over trademark.

text.p: Lawyers for Kids World Licensing Inc said on Monday the company has filed suit in U.S. District Court against Toys R Us Inc for alleged trademark infringement, unfair competition and deceptive trade practices.

Kids World Licensing alleged it owns the Kids World name and trademark and company affiliates own and operate retail stores in New Jersey and New York under that name. In November 1996, Toys R Us opened a retail complex in Elizabeth, N.J., using the Kids World name, according to a statement released by the law firm Goodkind Labaton Rudoff & Sucharow LLP.
Toys R Us officials were not available for comment.
Kids World Licensing's lawyers said Toys R Us purchased the Kids World name from a bankrupt Florida company in 1996, but the use of that name was limited to wholesale, not retail, activities.

Kids World Licensing's suit seeks an injunction restraining Toys R Us from using the Kids World name in retail sales of children's apparel, furniture or accessories. The suit also seeks payment of damages, the amount of which was not specified in the law firm's statement.
